scene_delta.title: Harim in Black Dress on Sofa
scene_delta.pose: Sitting gracefully on a plush, neutral-toned sofa, leaning slightly back with one arm resting on the sofa armrest and her hands folded in her lap.
scene_delta.expression: Calm and serene expression, subtle smile, eyes looking directly at the camera with a soft, intelligent gaze.
scene_delta.outfit: Elegant black midi-length sleeveless dress with a high neckline, cinched at the narrow waist to highlight her silhouette, fabric draping smoothly over her hips, paired with simple black heels.
scene_delta.camera: Medium shot, waist-up crop, framing from the mid-torso to the top of the head, ensuring the crop boundary ends clearly above the hips and crotch.
scene_delta.lens: 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, creating a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the living room background.
scene_delta.lighting: Soft, warm indoor lighting from a side window, creating gentle highlights on her soft pale skin and realistic hair texture.
scene_delta.location: A modern, minimalist living room with a clean, neutral-toned sofa and subtle interior decor.
scene_delta.action: Relaxing comfortably on the sofa, posing for a sophisticated portrait.
scene_delta.styling: Long straight dark hair styled neatly with realistic strand definition, minimal natural makeup to accentuate her refined cat-like facial features, small elegant silver earrings.
scene_delta.negative_constraints: No other people, no exaggerated bust, no skeletal appearance, no visible rib protrusion, no messy hair, no bright harsh lighting, no cropped-off limbs, no revealing clothing that leaves the lower body accidentally unclothed.
